regime_context: Semiconductors leads a narrow tech rotation (6 eligible of 22 themes) with AI Compute & Optics a very close challenger (margin 0.013). The absolute-trend gate historically did NOT reduce drawdown on China A-shares (gate_helps=false), so any trend discipline is experimental. Past calls on this market are 0-for-3, warranting extreme humility.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors is the eligible headline with a durable trend (durability_bar 0.69, hurst 'trend'), decent breadth (0.591) and no crowding. While the gate lacks historical drawdown protection here, the ongoing trend structure favours a long bias until the falsifier triggers.
theses.dissent: Backtest shows mean-reverting whipsaws; a policy or geopolitical shock could abruptly break the trend, and the gate did not shield drawdown historically.

falsifier.text: Semiconductors loses eligibility (durability_bar drops below ~0.4 and/or hurst tag turns 'mean-revert') OR AI Compute & Optics overtakes as headline with a margin >0.05 and its own durability >0.5, signalling rotation away.

theses.subject: Battery & Lithium
theses.thesis: Battery & Lithium is ineligible (absolute-trend gate off), holds negative momentum (score -1.027, durability_bar 0.36, breadth 0.062) and lacks trend health. The model would avoid it; underweight until theme re-enters eligibility or shows a momentum floor.
theses.dissent: A sudden policy catalyst (new NEV subsidy, raw-material shock) could spark a sharp relief rally; ineligibility does not rule out a short-term bounce.

falsifier.text: Battery & Lithium becomes eligible (durability_bar rises >0.5 and score turns positive) OR breadth improves above 0.5, indicating a trend reversal.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
